scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Head to Alberta and enter the Merchant Guild in the southwest corner (alberta 36,42). Inside talk to Chief Mahnsoo (Merchant) behind the desk to sign up to become a Merchant.
1.short_ru: Войдите в Merchant Guild (alberta 36,42) и поговорите с Chief Mahnsoo.
1.short_en: Enter Merchant Guild (alberta 36,42) and talk to Chief Mahnsoo.
1.full_ru: Идите в Alberta и войдите в Merchant Guild в юго-западном углу (alberta 36,42). Внутри поговорите с Chief Mahnsoo (Merchant) за столом и запишитесь на получение профессии Merchant.
1.full_en: Head to Alberta and enter the Merchant Guild in the southwest corner (alberta 36,42). Inside talk to Chief Mahnsoo (Merchant) behind the desk to sign up to become a Merchant.

2.original_instruction: He will ask you to pay a fee of 1,000 Zeny before beginning the quest. You can pay half (500z) before and half (500z) after the quest if you lack the funds. You will also be given a serial number and destination. Do not forget them! The serial number is randomly chosen between one of these: | 2485741 | 2328137 | 2989396 | 2191737 | 3012685 | 3487372 | 3318702 | 3543625 The destination is one of the following: | Izlude Dungeon (Bylan Island) - Kafra Employee (106,58) | Prontera - Southeastern corner, Kafra Employee (248,42) | Geffen - Mage Guild in the northwest building, to the man with glasses (in: 155,122) | Morroc - Dyemaker's house in the northeastern house, he is located in the room directly to the right after you enter the house (271,269)
2.short_ru: Заплатите 1,000 Zeny сразу или по 500z до и после задания; запомните назначенные номер и пункт доставки.
2.short_en: Pay 1,000 Zeny now or 500z before and after the quest; remember the assigned serial number and destination.
2.full_ru: Он попросит заплатить 1,000 Zeny перед началом задания. Если денег не хватает, можно внести половину (500z) до задания и половину (500z) после. Вам также назначат серийный номер и пункт доставки — запомните их. Случайно назначается один из номеров: 2485741, 2328137, 2989396, 2191737, 3012685, 3487372, 3318702, 3543625. Возможен один пункт доставки: Izlude Dungeon (Bylan Island) — Kafra Employee (106,58); Prontera, юго-восточный угол — Kafra Employee (248,42); Geffen, Mage Guild в северо-западном здании — man with glasses (in: 155,122); Morroc, Dyemaker's house в северо-восточном доме, в комнате справа от входа (271,269).

3.original_instruction: Head down into the warehouse and speak with the warehouse supervisor (alberta_in 28,29). You must the enter the serial number as well as the destination of the parcel. The supervisor will give you a parcel even if you enter the wrong serial number and/or destination, but the receiving NPC will not accept it, thus requiring the player to start over.
3.short_ru: У warehouse supervisor (alberta_in 28,29) введите назначенные номер и пункт доставки; ошибочный parcel не примут.
3.short_en: At the warehouse supervisor (alberta_in 28,29), enter the assigned serial and destination; an incorrect parcel will be rejected.
3.full_ru: Спуститесь в склад и поговорите с warehouse supervisor (alberta_in 28,29). Введите назначенные серийный номер и пункт доставки parcel. Даже при ошибке в номере или пункте вы получите parcel, но receiving NPC его не примет и придётся начать заново. Возможные серийные номера: 2485741, 2328137, 2989396, 2191737, 3012685, 3487372, 3318702, 3543625. Введите только назначенный вам номер.

reviews.detail: The eight serials are possible character-specific inputs, not eight correct answers. No serial/destination mapping is invented. Wrong input still issues a parcel, but the recipient rejects it; the source does not establish an extra fee or exact restart milestone.

One 1000-Zeny fee has alternative upfront or 500+500 arrangements. Final remaining 500 is conditional, not a second obligation. One parcel leads to one Receipt only on correct delivery; final presentation does not establish inventory consumption.

Bylan and Prontera Kafra Employees are distinct scoped actors. Geffen contact and Morroc recipient remain descriptive unknown identities. Four destinations are alternatives; bare points gain no guessed map codes, and the Morroc point is not asserted as an exact indoor NPC point.
